dp_moment_interpretation: For nondegenerate raw Cauchy releases, ordinary population bias is undefined and population MSE is infinite. DP Monte Carlo mean error, empirical MSE and empirical RMSE describe this finite run only; no tail observations are discarded or output-clipped.
